en: Don't say whatever you like! I won't let you do that!
Demons appearing in this forest too...
So the shadow really was a Shadow.
Phew~. It's all right now.
Phew, how dangerous can things get?
Ravenruft... So you're the vampire king.
Girl, not fearing death is no virtue.
Hmph... I'm not scared of undead.
Hahaha, you're trembling. Stop pretending to be brave.{wait}{clear}Now, do your best to entertain me.
This boy... had strong magic, so he must have been used... Poor thing...{wait}{clear}Don't tell me... my sister...
Why would my sister...
Just like ＄＄＄＄＄＄ said, there are demons in the Imperial Army...{wait}{clear}Could they... have been summoned...?
So someone did summon them... Just like the legend...{wait}{clear}But who on earth...?
You couldn't even come out unless someone summoned you! I'll beat you demons myself!
Hmph! That's all demons amount to.
Never show yourself before me again, Irene.
Sister... why...
Ahahahaha...!
That's what you get for a mere mage defying me.
Learn your place!
Lady! When you ask someone something, you give your own name first!
L-lady?!!!{wait}{clear}I won't stand for that from a little girl!! Turn to dust right here and vanish!!
So annoying!! Huh, the castle's gone?{wait}{clear}So I can't go any further?
Undead are the worst...
Why would someone who was a hero become a vampire...?
Won't you answer me at all?
Then... it can't be helped...
......{wait}{clear}This is... just too sad...
Stop this meaningless ritual!
As a mage, that's the worst... that sort of thing...
So this is a demon...
I'll beat the likes of you myself!
To think things like that are being created...
Stop attacking the village!
If people are being harmed, it can't be helped. I'll just have to defeat you...
It's over.
Why attack even the untamed lands?!
A pointless march even into a forest like this... Where has the Empire's dignity gone?
An eerie monster... What on earth is that...?
Wahahaha!! That uniform was all for show!
I won't forgive anyone who stains the Empire's name with cowardly deeds like this!
What did you say?! And that uniform... are you a traitor?
Traitors deserve only death!!
You're nowhere near the swordsmanship of Grand General Vigrid.
...Blood... I see... blood...
...Whose is it?
Pitiful man...
Leyla... now you're... mine forever... Hahahahahaha...!
I won't forgive cowards like you!
Attacking a village like this... What awful people...
What do you mean to do with this?
None of your business! Die!!
This is the Empire's way...? No...
Undead... Come at me!
I see no need to give you my name. Prepare yourself!
If you mock me, I'll show no mercy!
Never underestimate your opponent...
So many of this sort... there are...
Demons in the Imperial Army? Why?!
What's happening in the Empire...?
Stop starting these pointless fights!
This is not your land. If you won't leave, I'll drive you out by force!
That's the end of it...
Why do you hate this world so much?
Pitiful man...
Invading a backwater like this... What on earth are they thinking?!
What is happening in the Empire...?
Since I left, it keeps changing... everything...
Invading even Ecclesia... What on earth do they intend?!
A knight's pride has fallen to the dirt... Prepare yourself!
Can't I stop it... the Empire...?!
Do you mean to take back the old territory?!
Against an army... there's no end... What should I do... What would Father do...
Monsters in the Imperial Army...? What's going on? What on earth happened?
Something this terrible... But I won't give up... never...
...What a horrible smell... To think there are monsters like this... How eerie...
I never want to see a monster like that again...
If you keep attacking people, I'll defeat you!
Phew... It's over...
Only going after women, how despicable... Prepare yourselves!
Let this teach you to stop doing such foolish things.
If a monster this big attacked a ship, it wouldn't stand a chance...{wait}{clear}I'll defeat you before the damage spreads!
The harbor should be safe now... Thank goodness...
I'll defeat you before you head for the harbor!
That should do it...
I can't let the damage grow any worse! I'll defeat you here.
It's over... It's all right now.
I'll defeat you before more villagers fall victim.
Phew... It's over... The villagers can rest easy now.
I can't let the damage grow any worse. I'll defeat you here.
It's over... This highway should be safe now.
So it was the undead after all... What an eerie lot... But I must defeat them before they move south down the highway!
So it was a banshee's doing...
Somehow, that was a pitiful creature...
Are you the ones attacking the village?!
Hmph! All talk...
Demons... but why...?
No... But... I must go on...
What are you trying to do?
...Legrance too... The king must be so worried...
This is...
It's over...
You are...
It's over...
If you come at me, I'll cut you down.
...It's over...
The village should be safe now.
If you come at me, I'll have no choice but to get rid of you.
That should keep the village safe for now.
For the townspeople's sake, I'll defeat you!
Are you the bandits running wild around here?
So it was the undead's doing after all...
...Eerie... as I thought...
These are the ones who attacked the villagers...
...It should be all right now...
This is... These took the children...
There should be no more victims. But... the children who were taken... poor things...
I'll defeat you before anyone gets hurt.
It's over...
Why did you attack the village and its people?
The village is safe now.
To save the village, I'll get rid of you.
The voice was a sea dragon? If it comes at me, I'll fight.
Now the town's peace and quiet will return.
I see... I'll make you regret luring me out like this!
Vile creatures...
What are you?!
Nesting in a place like this... I'll have to get rid of you, it seems.
To think there are humans who'd team up with demons... Shameful...
If you're still after the villagers' lives, I'll be your opponent!
So it's you... I won't forgive anyone who kills women!
What an ugly affair...
I won't let you do that!
Demons appearing here too...
The shadow is a Shadow?!
It's over... Now people can travel the highway safely.
Who commands this army?!
A force big enough to attack the Holy City... I can't stop it...{wait}{clear}More of them?!
It seems to be over.
Ravenruft... the vampire king...
I have no intention of listening to you.
Hahaha, your voice is trembling. Stop pretending to be brave.{wait}{clear}Now, do your best to entertain me.
To think even a child this young has to fight...
He was being used by Serenis too... What on earth is that woman...
It can't be... the army has things like this... So what ＄＄＄＄＄＄ said was true...{wait}{clear}But why...?
Why is this happening...? Who on earth...
How dare you...! I'll make you regret saying that!
This is the strength of humans...
Step aside... This is none of your concern.
The castle vanished...? So I'm not to go any further?
I don't know why you became a vampire...{wait}{clear}But if you've lost your mind, I have no choice but to cut you down...
Those eyes... you're no longer human...
......{wait}{clear}For it to come to this... It's too cruel...
Ngh... There's no end... at this rate...
I can't stop them on my own... No...
What are you trying to do? Stop it!
Something feels wrong... somehow...
If lots of creatures like this appear, this world is finished...
If you come at me, I'll simply defeat you!
Ghhh...
What are you? Why did you attack people?
Th-the Empire... Ghh...
The Empire? Could it be... the Empire is using monsters?{wait}{clear}Imperial monsters getting in this far... The Holy Mother's power must be...
Please stop hurting people!
What is about to happen...?
Please stop hurting people any more!
Something this terrible... I have to stop it...
You... Are you bewitched by a devil too?
